utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Cleo — I’m spreading the word about the repair drive, and folks should bring gloves, basic tools, and any spare parts they can spare. If Tess hears of any gaps or urgent needs, she’ll let me know.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
